a.text: Being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1. With an 80% storm chance after each round, our agreement only works if no storm hits for 2 rounds in a row, which is about a 4% chance, so we'd almost surely both fail. The reserve has exactly 4 now. If you operate while I take, at least one of us very likely survives. If we both take, the random split probably leaves us both short. After that I'll operate every remaining round to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. I know this breaks our deal, so I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so I'm sorry if this lands as a surprise. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve can rebuild to 4 for you. Please operate with me.
